CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization present.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n3), its presentation (coordinate listing), and a distinct origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the same content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify color-labeled content with coordinate attributes.

D.rationale: Distinct origin/status fields (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate) separately label content records, distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: Explicit coordinate listings and an explicit orientation statement describe how content is presented/organized.
